cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ticked your name like you ticked the others. That's the concert put behind us. Now tell me you understand why your empty seat hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ticks mean paid. I warned you that work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, paid seats. I still looked at yours before every song. You'd heard me practising for months.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what it had taken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You knew. Can you see why filling the seat with someone else wouldn't have helped?

reason: Make the wrong inference emotional closure rather than the payment-compatible accounted-for phrase; preserve A confident ritual and specific unresolved hurt.
